decisions.reason: Demand for flexible, representative workplaces after the pandemic gives the multi-model height-adjustable desk line real remaining upside, and keeping this established option open costs little.
The chair family shares the core production base, so carrying it is cheap, and a chair family usually serves as a long-lived anchor that complements the desk and sofa ranges.
The sofa has had only weak website emphasis, which signals limited value, but it is close to the core upholstery competence and cheap to keep, so it stays while its results are monitored.

The rug collection is distant from the core and more costly to maintain, but as the strategic flagship of the firm's interior direction it remains a growth option worth keeping, even though the related floor cushions were dropped.
